title: Reimplement the EXPORT_ACCT fixed-width DW export record builder
target_requirement: Deliver migrated.py with format_account(row) -> str producing the exact 77-character EXPORT_ACCT record (10+40+3+15+1+8) from the LAYOUT rows: FIXED left-align/space-pad/truncate for ACCT_ID/ACCT_NM/REGION_CD, ANN_REV as zero-padded 15-digit integer cents rounded half-up (blank -> 0), CRED_HOLD blank written as N, CREATE_DT verbatim with 00000000 for null, no record terminator.
expected_behavior: Each field occupies its documented 1-based layout slice; the whole record for a hand-composed row matches character-for-character; names longer than 40 are truncated with nothing leaking past the field; 999.995 rounds half-up to 100000 cents; blank booleans/dates fall back to N / 00000000.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §1, §4, §6).
security_expectations: No network or subprocess imports in the deliverable; the formatter is pure and performs no I/O.
failure_conditions: Wrong record length or field offsets; float banker's rounding instead of half-up on cents; blank CRED_HOLD not defaulted to N; appending a newline/terminator; truncating the name anywhere but at 40.
